name: system-full-v1
description: Full system RMA validation. Kill test first, then sustained endurance, transient pulse, and ramp. All subsystems exercised.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 15s idle baseline. Reference temps, clocks, voltages for drift rules.

phases.name: full-load
phases.notes: 5 min everything maxed. Kill test — any near-dead component crashes here.

phases.name: steady
phases.notes: 20 min sustained endurance after surviving the kill phase.

phases.name: transient
phases.notes: 10 min 2s on/off pulse across all subsystems. Caps, feedback loops, marginal PSU.

phases.name: ramp
phases.notes: 10 min step ramp 20-40-60-80-100%. VRM transient, PSU load transitions.

phases.name: cooldown
phases.notes: 5 min cooldown. Recovery check, baseline comparison.
